title: Rail statistic display definitions
description: The statistics Rail displays, as data (docs/RAIL-PLAN.md R2.4, amendment A11; docs/STATS-SPEC.md section 13). Each is a formula over the per-seat counters of stats/2, which stay code. Read by the app and the HUD (core/rail-config parses and validates, core/rail-stats evaluates) and by the web (frontend/src/lib/stats/display.ts); both give the same number. What a schema cannot check - the formula's grammar, that every name in it is a counter, unique ids, ascending bands - core/rail-config checks at load and in CI.

version.description: Version of this file's shape. A file of another version is refused.

text.description: A string in every language the app and the web speak (lib/i18n LOCALES: en, hr). Shipped definitions carry their own words so the HUD (Rust, no JavaScript dictionary) and user-made statistics (R2.10) read names the same way.

formula.description: An expression over counter names: numbers, names, + - * /, unary minus, parentheses, pct(made, opportunities) = made * 100 / opportunities, sum(a, b, ...). Evaluated as JavaScript numbers (IEEE-754 doubles) left to right; a division by zero, pct over no opportunities, or a missing input gives no value. Names: every stats/2 counter (COUNTER_KEYS), every money column (MONEY_KEYS), money_hands, and ev_net_bb_milli (the hero's all-in EV result).

tone.description: A position on the HUD's colour scale, not a colour: the app, the web and the HUD map it to their theme's tokens.

below.description: The band holds values below this (and at or above the previous band's). Absent on the last band, which holds the rest. A decimal with at most 15 significant digits.

id.description: Stable identifier; layouts and user overrides refer to it.

players.description: Whose rows it can be computed for: any player, or the hero only (all-in EV exists for the hero only).

label.description: The short label a HUD panel prints (VPIP, 3B, F3B).

unit.description: percent: percentage points (print with %); bb_per_100 and bb: big blinds; ratio: a plain ratio; count: a whole number; money: minor units of the sample's one currency.

decimals.description: Digits after the point, as the web's Intl.NumberFormat rounds them: the shortest decimal that reads back as the double, half away from zero. For money, digits of the major unit.

sample.description: The sample the value stands on, for the reliability shown next to it (R2.5): full opacity from min upwards.

of.description: A formula giving the sample size. Optional when the formula is pct(made, opportunities): then it is the opportunities.

min.description: The sample from which the value is shown at full opacity.

bands.description: Colour thresholds in ascending order, compared with the unrounded value. Empty: no colour.

hud.description: Default HUD membership: the panel (4-6 statistics), the popup, or neither. The user's HUD editor (R3.9) overrides it.
